context_for_next_testing_agent: THE FORGE V2 is a NEW 24-page cinematic presentation with 'left-aligned, industrial, hard-cut' design language. Different from V1 which uses Playfair Display serif font - V2 uses Oswald condensed sans-serif. Routes: /proposals/preview/the-forge-v2 (no auth, direct access), /proposals/the-forge-v2 (email gate). All data hardcoded in TheForgeV2Presentation.jsx. Features: Amber 'THE FORGE' letter ignition animation on pages 1 and 24, 50ms amber flash transition between pages, ember particles floating upward, video on page 2 with autoplay, character pages 10-14 with CharSplit template (50/50 split layout), page 14 MARCUS HALE has cold blue background (#070B12) for temperature contrast, CSS-only animations via data-active attribute and animation classes (ab=burn, ad=drop, asl/asr=slide, af=fadeIn, au=fadeUp, ar=riseUp, adh=drawH, adv=drawV, aig=ignite, abr=bright), full keyboard/touch navigation, progress bar at bottom. Color palette: Industrial black #0A0705, Amber #E8791A, Bronze #A0622A, Warm white #F5EAD7, Cold blue #070B12 (villain only). Fonts: Oswald condensed sans-serif for headings (.fv2-h), Inter for body. Images reused from /app/frontend/public/images/theforge/ (same as V1).
